podcast.body: A song that started as a local hit in Belgium, then became regional, and spread internationally through 1996 after being picked up by American label 550 Music (part of the Sony Empire). It caught fire in North America at the end of the Grunge era, though five of the album's six singles went nowhere in North America. The lyrics were written by Sarah Bettens, better known as Sam in the 90s, and are primarily about addiction, specifically cigarettes, though Bettens was also experimenting with acid and mushrooms at the time. As of February 2026, it had approximately 27 million Spotify plays and 7.5 million YouTube views, totaling 38.4 million, with a One Hit Wonder Power Ranking of 3.36 out of 10. "Yes, it's about addiction, primarily cigarettes, actually."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: Released in 1996, "Not An Addict" became K's Choice's only major hit, achieving Top 40 status in numerous countries and becoming an alt-rock hit in North America. The song's success led to the band touring with Alanis Morissette, who was at the height of her popularity with the *Jagged Little Pill* album. The band has never been able to replicate this song's success. "And this one blew up, reaching the top 40 in a bunch of countries."
